title: Ratings and contact mentions
summary: This topic mainly consists of brief references to ratings, contact, and general impressions, with only limited concrete feedback about technical capability and expectations for a sports car.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car's technical capability and high reputation, with one fragment also referencing expectations around sports-car character.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention numeric ratings, higher intended scores, quick contact response, or a request to be contacted without enough detail to identify a clear product sentiment.

limitations: Most fragments are too short or vague to determine a clear sentiment or a specific vehicle aspect.
The cluster mixes ratings language, dealer or contact interaction, and limited vehicle comments, so it is not a fully coherent single theme.
Examples are insufficient to separate feedback about the vehicle from feedback about sales or service contact in some fragments.
